Portfolio value graph across every wallet in the workspace, including wallets not assigned to any portfolio. Point spacing adapts to the range: 1D/1W return hourly points, 1M returns 4-hourly, and 3M/1Y/ALL return daily. Read `granularity` from the response rather than inferring it — a short range falls back to daily when hourly history does not reach that far back.
